text_block_list.text:
"Who's my name?" "King!" ...The Trainer is 
roped into going along with her strange 
roll call. The selfish young lady is in 
top form.

Doing whatever she pleased even during 
training, she called in reporters to 
interview her, but Air Groove stepped in 
to scold her.

As one daughter of a race-winning mother 
to another... Air Groove offers some 
advice. However, King Halo refuses to 
listen.

To the world that only sees her as a 'fine 
young lady.' To the mother who bluntly 
told her she had no talent— She felt 
obligated to make them acknowledge her 
worth.
